LESSON: RHYTHM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.2: Rhythm

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Rhythm
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can various note combinations be used to form rhythms in simple time?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the effect of note extension on rhythmic patterns
2. compose a four-bar rhythmic pattern in 4 4 time
3. appreciate rhythmic patterns as a means of creating interest in Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe the effect of note extension on rhythmic patterns

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 2: compose a four-bar rhythmic pattern in 4 4 time
• Model 3: appreciate rhythmic patterns as a means of creating interest in Creative Arts and Sports

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: describe the effect of note extension on rhythmic patterns
2. Practise: compose a four-bar rhythmic pattern in 4 4 time

SECTION: WORK TO DO

2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

1. How can various note combinations be used to form rhythms in simple time?
2. How can one improvise accompaniment patterns for Sports?
